stem: Both Silver in the article “Sticking to It” and the speaker in the poem “An Unexpected Gift” create something useful. How is this experience DIFFERENT for Silver?

options.label: A
options.text: He creates his design as part of a contest.

options.label: B
options.text: He feels great pride in the success of his creation.

options.label: C
options.text: He finds the suggestion for his design in nature.

options.label: D
options.text: He has to wait much longer to see his work finished.

notes: Extracted as a multiple choice STAAR problem with all answer choices and preserved formatting.
